methodology.order: All six engine permutations, repeated equally
methodology.cold: Application layout cache cleared; fonts, WASM, JIT and internal font caches already warm
methodology.edit: Independent baseline prime, then insert one character in the middle paragraph
methodology.resize: Independent baseline prime at 450px, then layout at 350px
methodology.timed: Synchronous Engine.layout call, including current adapters; excludes prime, clear, dispose, geometry queries, drawing, startup and event processing
methodology.p95: Nearest rank, sample 29 of 30 sorted observations
methodology.scope: Current whole-document adapters; not native engine maxima or main-editor block-cache performance
